inspect.rule: tenantId must equal the trusted runtime tenant; return the current project manager, lifecycle, stage, project version, participant fact version and ACTION_EDIT tree version without a write

lockAndRevalidate.rule: join the caller transaction; lock and compare every frozen axis before COM locks or writes

qualification.subject: actorId must equal the current PROJECT_MANAGER; global role or ordinary participation is insufficient
qualification.scope: the same actor and target project must satisfy current ProjectScopeApi.ACTION_EDIT
qualification.stage: return the current S0-S6 stage and compare it exactly during revalidation; S5/S6 and either closed lifecycle remain valid facts used by COM to protect reductions as CONFLICT

forbidden: reuse ProjectParticipantFactApi ACTIVE/S1 revalidation for this purpose
map every PROJ failure to provider unavailable
accept subject, scope or stale failures as partial success
